up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1614544'. For each activity, provide the following details: the assay CHEMBL ID, the compound CHEMBL ID, the compound's canonical SMILES, the activity standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Do not apply any filters beyond the assay identifier; include all activity records regardless of relation or units. Return all resulting rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units FROM activities act JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614544';
